FROM DixonDoctor doc LEFT OUTER JOIN DixonPhoneNumber ph ON doc.phoneNumber = ph.id
WHERE doc.name LIKE @search1 OR doc.name LIKE @search2;

SELECT n.noticeID, n.noticeType, n.noticeStatus, DATE_FORMAT(n.sentDate, "%m-%d-%Y") AS 'sentDate', n.message, doc.name AS docName, pa.name AS paName, ph.name AS phName FROM DixonNotice n LEFT OUTER JOIN DixonDoctor doc ON n.doctorSender = doc.id LEFT OUTER JOIN DixonPatient pa ON n.patientSender = pa.patientID LEFT OUTER JOIN DixonPharmacy ph ON n.pharmacySender = ph.id WHERE pharmacyReceiver = @id ORDER BY n.noticeStatus ASC
UPDATE DixonNotice SET noticeStatus = 'Received' WHERE noticeID = @id
INSERT INTO DixonNotice (noticeType, noticeStatus, sentDate, message, pharmacySender, doctorReceiver)
INSERT INTO DixonNotice (noticeType, noticeStatus, sentDate, message, pharmacySender, patientReceiver)
INSERT INTO DixonNotice (noticeType, noticeStatus, sentDate, message, pharmacySender, patientReceiver)
INSERT INTO DixonNotice (noticeType, noticeStatus, sentDate, message, pharmacySender, patientReceiver)
SELECT name, DATE_FORMAT(birthDate, "%m-%d-%Y") AS birthDate, patientID FROM DixonPatient
WHERE name LIKE @searchKey1 OR name LIKE @searchKey2;

SELECT m.name, DATE_FORMAT(pr.dateFilled, "%m-%d-%Y") AS dateFilled, m.quantity, m.dosage, m.route, m.instructions, m.prescriptionID FROM DixonPatient pa JOIN DixonPrescription pr ON pr.patientID = pa.patientID JOIN DixonMedicine m ON m.prescriptionID = pr.id WHERE pa.patientID = @id;
SELECT height, weight, maritalStatus, disorders, allergies, notes FROM DixonMedicalRecord WHERE patientID = @id;
SELECT m.name, m.quantity, m.dosage, m.route, m.instructions FROM DixonPrescription pr JOIN DixonMedicine m ON m.prescriptionID = pr.id WHERE pr.id = @id;
pr.remainingRefills, pr.prescriptionStatus, pa.name AS patientName, pa.patientID,
FROM(DixonPrescription pr JOIN DixonPatient pa ON pr.patientID = pa.patientID JOIN DixonDoctor doc ON pr.doctorID = doc.id)
WHERE pr.pharmacyID = @id AND pr.prescriptionStatus != 'Deleted' ORDER BY pr.prescriptionStatus DESC, pr.dateFilled DESC;
pr.remainingRefills, pr.prescriptionStatus, pa.name AS patientName, pa.patientID,
FROM DixonPrescription pr JOIN DixonPatient pa ON pr.patientID = pa.patientID
JOIN DixonDoctor doc ON pr.doctorID = doc.id JOIN DixonPharmacy ph ON pr.pharmacyID = ph.id
WHERE (doc.name LIKE @searchKey1 OR doc.name LIKE @searchKey2) AND ph.id = @id AND pr.prescriptionStatus != 'Deleted';
pr.remainingRefills, pr.prescriptionStatus, pa.name AS patientName, pa.patientID,
FROM DixonPrescription pr JOIN DixonPatient pa ON pr.patientID = pa.patientID
JOIN DixonDoctor doc ON pr.doctorID = doc.id JOIN DixonPharmacy ph ON pr.pharmacyID = ph.id
WHERE (pa.name LIKE @searchKey1 OR pa.name LIKE @searchKey2) AND ph.id = @id AND pr.prescriptionStatus != 'Deleted';
UPDATE DixonPrescription SET prescriptionStatus = 'Active' WHERE id = @id;
